original_source_opened.title: Weighted Completion of Galois Groups and Galois Actions on the Fundamental Group
original_source_opened.anchors: sections8.4 and8.5, printed pp27–28, before Theorem8.7
original_source_opened.finding: The normalized tangential pro-l automorphism action is unramified outside N*l. For N=1,l=2, inertia3 is in its kernel.

proof_checks: Actual arithmetic g exists from U x C3 surjectivity; commutator has full cyclotomic1 and exact Kummer constraints.
Identity sphere action and rank4 lift use actual characteristic source maps.
Coprime centralizer lifting applies to the literal quotient cosets and supplies both simultaneous conjugators.
Actual source retains every pure F^(p) quotient, proving full Fhat-prime preimage.
D25.6 recovers the new CM coordinates from G2/G3; they are invariant under the remaining centralizer choices.
Solvable finite images of U and exact sign give the remaining A7 source-kernel image.
scope: D.46 constructs a replacement on the entire relative pronilpotent completion of the rank97 subgroup N. Its full relative pro2 action is an actual Galois commutator with identity sphere projection and compact elliptic scalar eta*, while every odd relative component is identity. The exact conjugator tuple has an actual full Fhat-prime parameter, and its G2/G3 projections recover the prescribed CM pair T4=I,W3=[i]. All six finite arithmetic framings give that pair. The replacement solves the entire rank4 relative pro2 lifting step; it changes the excluded old sphere action already in degree7. The exact remaining full-source kernel has A7 image under the displayed S7 quotient. Full profinite realization remains open.
